from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_saved_high_score_leaf_contribution_v1'
PRIOR=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1'
if (OUT/'result.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('解释结果已存在，禁止重跑。')
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def clean(x):
    if isinstance(x,dict):return {str(k):clean(v) for k,v in x.items()}
    if isinstance(x,(list,tuple)):return [clean(v) for v in x]
    if isinstance(x,(datetime,pd.Timestamp)):return x.isoformat()
    if isinstance(x,(np.integer,np.floating,np.bool_)):return clean(x.item())
    if isinstance(x,float) and not math.isfinite(x):return None
    return x
def save(name,obj):
    p=OUT/name
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError('禁止覆盖解释结果：'+name)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(clean(obj),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
protocol=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for spec in protocol['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/spec['path'])==spec['sha256']
original_contract=json.loads((PRIOR/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
features={8:original_contract['features8'],10:original_contract['features8']+original_contract['features10_added']}
data={8:pd.read_parquet(PRIOR/'纠错八变量历史输入及原标签.parquet'),10:pd.read_parquet(PRIOR/'纠错十变量历史输入及原标签.parquet')}
models={n:{int(s['idx']):s for s in json.loads((PRIOR/('纠错'+str(n)+'变量保存模型.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))} for n in [8,10]}
pools={int(s['idx']):s for s in json.loads((PRIOR/'共同成熟训练池.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
scores={n:pd.read_csv(PRIOR/('纠错'+str(n)+'变量每日联合评分.csv')).set_index('idx') for n in [8,10]}
events=pd.read_csv(PRIOR/'固定高分不重叠机会.csv')
events=events[events.version.eq('同参数纠错')].copy()
assert len(events)==70
def assign_leaf(x,spec):
    xf=np.asarray(x,dtype=np.float32)
    left=np.asarray(spec['tree_children_left'],int)
    right=np.asarray(spec['tree_children_right'],int)
    feature=np.asarray(spec['tree_feature'],int)
    threshold=np.asarray(spec['tree_threshold'],float)
    nodes=np.zeros(len(xf),dtype=int)
    for step in range(4):
        active=left[nodes]>=0
        if not active.any():return nodes
        rows=np.flatnonzero(active);at=nodes[rows]
        go_left=xf[rows,feature[at]]<=threshold[at]
        nodes[rows]=np.where(go_left,left[at],right[at])
    assert (left[nodes]<0).all()
    return nodes
def path_for(current,spec,F):
    path=[];node=0;xf=np.asarray(current,dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1)
    while spec['tree_children_left'][node]>=0:
        j=int(spec['tree_feature'][node]);threshold=float(spec['tree_threshold'][node])
        left=bool(xf[j]<=threshold)
        path.append({'node':node,'feature':F[j],'current_original_value':float(np.asarray(current).reshape(-1)[j]),'tree_float32_value':float(xf[j]),'threshold':threshold,'branch':'小于等于' if left else '大于'})
        node=int(spec['tree_children_left'][node] if left else spec['tree_children_right'][node])
    return node,path
case_rows=[];member_rows=[];month_rows=[];paths=[];leaf_sets={}
for event in events.itertuples(index=False):
    n=int(event.features);i=int(event.signal_idx)
    d=data[n];F=features[n];spec=models[n][i];pool=pools[i]
    indices=np.asarray(pool['training_indices'],int)
    assert len(indices)==int(spec['n_train'])
    expected_mask=(d.idx>=i-504)&(d.exit_idx<=i)&(d.valid_features if n==8 else d.valid_ten_features)&d.net_label.notna()
    assert np.array_equal(indices,np.flatnonzero(expected_mask.to_numpy()))
    assert (d.exit_idx.iloc[indices]<=i).all()
    assert int(d.exit_idx.iloc[indices].max())==int(spec['training_label_max_idx'])
    current=d.loc[i,F].to_numpy(float).reshape(1,-1)
    leaf,path=path_for(current,spec,F)
    assert int(assign_leaf(current,spec)[0])==leaf
    pool_x=d.iloc[indices][F].to_numpy(float)
    leaves=assign_leaf(pool_x,spec)
    leaf_indices=indices[leaves==leaf]
    assert len(leaf_indices)==int(spec['tree_samples'][leaf])
    y=d.net_label.iloc[leaf_indices].to_numpy(float)
    prediction=float(spec['tree_value'][leaf])
    assert abs(float(y.mean())-prediction)<1e-12
    assert abs(prediction-float(event.prediction))<1e-12
    assert abs(prediction-float(scores[n].loc[i,'nonlinear_prediction']))<1e-12
    positive=np.maximum(y,0)
    positive_sum=float(positive.sum())
    assert positive_sum>0 and prediction>0
    leaf_sets[(n,i)]=leaf_indices.tolist()
    path_features=[p['feature'] for p in path]
    paths.append({'features':n,'signal_idx':i,'signal_date':event.signal_date,'era':event.era,'leaf':leaf,'path':path,'saved_prediction':prediction})
    leaf_frame=pd.DataFrame({'features':n,'signal_idx':i,'signal_date':event.signal_date,'era':event.era,'leaf':leaf,'training_idx':leaf_indices,'label_signal_date':d.date.iloc[leaf_indices].to_numpy(),'label_entry_date':d.date.iloc[leaf_indices+1].to_numpy(),'label_exit_date':d.date.iloc[leaf_indices+6].to_numpy(),'mature_net5':y,'positive_contribution':positive,'negative_contribution':np.minimum(y,0)})
    leaf_frame['label_signal_month']=pd.to_datetime(leaf_frame.label_signal_date).dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
    member_rows.extend(leaf_frame.to_dict(orient='records'))
    grouped=leaf_frame.groupby('label_signal_month',sort=True).agg(members=('training_idx','size'),net_label_sum=('mature_net5','sum'),positive_label_sum=('positive_contribution','sum'),negative_label_sum=('negative_contribution','sum')).reset_index()
    grouped['positive_label_share']=grouped.positive_label_sum/positive_sum
    for row in grouped.itertuples(index=False):
        month_rows.append({'features':n,'signal_idx':i,'signal_date':event.signal_date,'era':event.era,'leaf':leaf,'label_signal_month':row.label_signal_month,'members':int(row.members),'net_label_sum':float(row.net_label_sum),'positive_label_sum':float(row.positive_label_sum),'negative_label_sum':float(row.negative_label_sum),'positive_label_share':float(row.positive_label_share)})
    assert abs(float(grouped.net_label_sum.sum())-float(y.sum()))<1e-12
    peak=grouped.loc[grouped.positive_label_share.idxmax()]
    components=0;end=-1;boundaries={}
    for j in sorted(leaf_indices.tolist()):
        a=j+1;b=j+6
        if a>=end:components+=1
        end=max(end,b)
        boundaries[a]=boundaries.get(a,0)+1
        boundaries[b]=boundaries.get(b,0)-1
    live=0;max_overlap=0
    for t in sorted(boundaries):
        live+=boundaries[t];max_overlap=max(max_overlap,live)
    best=int(np.argmax(y))
    case_rows.append({'features':n,'signal_idx':i,'signal_date':event.signal_date,'era':event.era,'leaf':leaf,'leaf_members':len(y),'leaf_mean':float(y.mean()),'leaf_median':float(np.median(y)),'positive_members':int((y>0).sum()),'negative_members':int((y<0).sum()),'saved_prediction':prediction,'actual_net5':float(event.net_event_return),'positive_label_sum':positive_sum,'negative_label_sum':float(np.minimum(y,0).sum()),'largest_positive_label_date':d.date.iloc[leaf_indices[best]],'largest_positive_label':float(y[best]),'largest_positive_label_share':float(y[best]/positive_sum),'largest_positive_month':peak.label_signal_month,'largest_positive_month_share':float(peak.positive_label_share),'largest_positive_month_members':int(peak.members),'overlap_connected_groups':components,'max_simultaneous_label_intervals':max_overlap,'path_features':'；'.join(path_features),'policy_or_funding_change_on_path':any(name in path_features for name in features[10][8:])})
cases=pd.DataFrame(case_rows)
members=pd.DataFrame(member_rows)
monthly=pd.DataFrame(month_rows)
cases.to_csv(OUT/'全部70事件保存叶分布.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
members.to_csv(OUT/'全部原叶训练成员.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
monthly.to_csv(OUT/'全部原叶逐月标签贡献.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
save('全部保存决策路径.json',paths)
summaries=[]
for n in [8,10]:
    for era in ['2021—2023','2024—2025']:
        b=cases[cases.features.eq(n)&cases.era.eq(era)]
        summaries.append({'features':n,'era':era,'events':len(b),'leaf_members_min':int(b.leaf_members.min()),'leaf_members_max':int(b.leaf_members.max()),'leaf_positive_mean_but_nonpositive_median_events':int(b.leaf_median.le(0).sum()),'single_month_over_half_positive_contribution_events':int(b.largest_positive_month_share.gt(.5).sum()),'largest_month_is_2024_09_events':int(b.largest_positive_month.eq('2024-09').sum()),'largest_positive_month_share_min':float(b.largest_positive_month_share.min()),'largest_positive_month_share_max':float(b.largest_positive_month_share.max()),'overlap_connected_groups_min':int(b.overlap_connected_groups.min()),'overlap_connected_groups_max':int(b.overlap_connected_groups.max()),'policy_or_funding_change_on_path_events':int(b.policy_or_funding_change_on_path.sum()),'mean_saved_prediction':float(b.saved_prediction.mean()),'mean_actual_net5':float(b.actual_net5.mean())})
main=cases[cases.era.eq('2024—2025')]
same_main_leafs=all(leaf_sets[(8,int(i))]==leaf_sets[(10,int(i))] for i in main.loc[main.features.eq(8),'signal_idx'])
main.to_csv(OUT/'主期全部保存叶解释.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
for spec in protocol['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/spec['path'])==spec['sha256']
save('保存结果必要核对.json',{'status':'PASS_ALL_70_SAVED_LEAF_MEMBERS_COUNTS_MEANS_AND_MATURITY','checked_at':now(),'parents_unchanged':len(protocol['parents']),'fixed_events':70,'primary_cases':18,'unique_primary_dates':9,'saved_leaf_membership_records':len(members),'all_calendar_month_rows':len(monthly),'saved_tree_counts_and_predictions_recovered':True,'all_training_labels_mature':True,'all_members_and_months_retained':True,'no_refit_or_member_removal':True,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0})
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E23','completed_at':now(),'status':'COMPLETED_SAVED_HIGH_SCORE_LEAF_TRAINING_CONTRIBUTIONS_EXPLAINED','classification':'PROGRESS_E23_SAVED_MODEL_POSITIVE_EXPECTATION_SOURCE_AND_OVERLAP_EXPLAINED','source_parents':len(protocol['parents']),'event_cases':70,'unique_primary_dates':9,'primary_model_cases':18,'leaf_membership_rows':len(members),'all_month_rows':len(monthly),'summaries':summaries,'primary_cases':main.to_dict(orient='records'),'same_main_leaf_members_for_8_and_10':same_main_leafs,'new_source_acquisitions':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'parameter_grids':0,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'historical_not_independent_validation':True,'interpretation':'说明正预测来自哪批成熟训练成员及其算术贡献；不能把历史叶路径变量识别为真实原因，也不能把相交组数冒称独立有效样本量。','facts_report':OUT.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()+'/高分为何预期反弹_保存叶结论.md'}
save('result.json',result)
lines=['# E23：下跌状态为何被原树预测为正收益','','本轮读取E21原保存树和成熟池，复算全部70个自然高分事件对应的叶成员。未重拟合、删除月份、重加权或改目标；原评分和失败保持。','','| 模型/时期 | 自然事件 | 单月贡献超全叶正标签和50%的事件 | 正均值但中位数非正的事件 | 叶成员数量范围 | 标签区间相交组数范围 |','|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
for s in summaries:
    lines.append('| '+str(s['features'])+'变量 '+s['era']+' | '+str(s['events'])+' | '+str(s['single_month_over_half_positive_contribution_events'])+' | '+str(s['leaf_positive_mean_but_nonpositive_median_events'])+' | '+str(s['leaf_members_min'])+'—'+str(s['leaf_members_max'])+' | '+str(s['overlap_connected_groups_min'])+'—'+str(s['overlap_connected_groups_max'])+' |')
lines+=['','主期两模型对应叶成员是否完全相同：'+('是。' if same_main_leafs else '否；逐笔原成员已保留。'),'','| 主期八变量信号日 | 保存预测 | 叶中位数 | 叶样本数 | 最大正贡献月及份额 | 原实际五日净收益 |','|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|']
for row in main[main.features.eq(8)].itertuples(index=False):
    lines.append('| '+row.signal_date+' | '+format(row.saved_prediction*100,'.4f')+'% | '+format(row.leaf_median*100,'.4f')+'% | '+str(row.leaf_members)+' | '+row.largest_positive_month+' / '+format(row.largest_positive_month_share*100,'.2f')+'% | '+format(row.actual_net5*100,'.4f')+'% |')
lines+=['','贡献是原训练标签对算术均值的分解，不是实际账户盈亏；按标签信号日归月，五日价格段可能跨月，不能归因于单月经济政策。全部月份和成员均保留；相交组是区间连接关系，不是独立样本估计。叶均值/中位数、变量路径或集中性都不证明该变量的因果作用，也不授权删除大涨标签来重新训练。','','[全部成员](全部原叶训练成员.csv)、[全部月份](全部原叶逐月标签贡献.csv)、[全部路径](全部保存决策路径.json)、[结果](result.json)、[必要核对](保存结果必要核对.json)。完整账户/夏普未计算，金融目标未达成。']
(OUT/'高分为何预期反弹_保存叶结论.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(clean({'状态':result['status'],'主期摘要':[s for s in summaries if s['era']=='2024—2025'],'主期8与10叶成员相同':same_main_leafs,'成员':len(members),'新拟合':0,'新账户':0,'目标':False}),ensure_ascii=False))
